items.title: Northflank security breach leads to abuse of customers' AI API keys
items.author: Lawrence Abrams
items.content: <article>Cloud application hosting platform Northflank is warning customers to rotate all credentials and secrets stored on its platform after a security breach led to unauthorized use of customers' AI API keys. [...]</article>

items.title: New Android SMS of Death exploit can remotely crash unpatched phones
items.author: Lawrence Abrams
items.content: <article>A security researcher has released a proof-of-concept exploit for a recently patched Android vulnerability, dubbed "SMS of Death" and tracked as CVE-2026-58882, that lets attackers remotely disrupt cellular service or crash phones by sending a specially crafted text message. [...]</article>

items.title: Reddit to lock content behind logins to fight scrapers
items.author: Bill Toulas
items.content: <article>Reddit announced in a post by co-founder Steve Huffman that the site will gradually become a "logged-in service," offering limited access to visitors without accounts. [...]</article>

items.title: From Beginner to Bug Hunter: Learning Cybersecurity in the AI Era.
items.author: Sponsored by TryHackMe
items.content: <article>AI-generated vulnerability reports are overwhelming some bug bounty programs, making it harder for aspiring security researchers to know where to start. TryHackMe explains how beginners can build practical cybersecurity skills, use AI responsibly, and produce reproducible findings that stand up to scrutiny. [...]</article>

items.title: Chainalysis discloses data breach from "offensive agentic techniques"
items.author: Ax Sharma
items.content: <article>Blockchain analytics firm Chainalysis disclosed a data breach after attackers used "offensive agentic techniques" to access internal systems and tools, exposing customer names, email addresses, user IDs, and organizational roles. [...]</article>

items.title: Critical Linux kernel flaw allows remote root attacks on MPTCP servers
items.author: Lawrence Abrams
items.content: <article>Security researchers at Anthropic have developed an exploit for a critical Linux kernel vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to remotely execute commands as root on servers running Multipath TCP (MPTCP) listeners. [...]</article>

items.title: Trezor warns of suspected crypto-theft implant in hardware wallet
items.author: Bill Toulas
items.content: <article>Hardware wallet device maker Trezor has received credible reports about a suspected hardware crypto-theft implant in a Trezor Safe 5 sold by its reseller CryptoBilis in Southeast Asia. [...]</article>

items.title: Malicious Claude Code extension on Cursor planted SSH backdoors
items.author: Bill Toulas
items.content: <article>A malicious version of Anthropic's Claude Code VS Code extension was distributed through Cursor's extension marketplace for approximately 11 hours on October 29, exposing up to 5,000 developers to malware designed to install persistent SSH backdoors. [...]</article>

items.title: SS7 and Diameter Attacks: How Signaling Flaws Expose Your Phone
items.author: Sponsored by Cape
items.content: <article>Flaws in SS7 and Diameter signaling protocols can allow attackers to track phone locations, intercept calls and SMS verification codes, and impersonate subscribers without compromising their devices. Cape explains how these attacks exploit trust between networks and how its security-focused mobile service helps defend against them. [...]</article>

items.title: CISA says max severity GitLab flaw now exploited in the wild
items.author: Sergiu Gatlan
items.content: <article>Attackers have started exploiting a maximum-severity GitLab vulnerability patched earlier this month, according to the US Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA). [...]</article>

items.title: Microsoft finally fixes VPN issues caused by September updates
items.author: Sergiu Gatlan
items.content: <article>Microsoft has resolved Always On VPN connection failures triggered after installing the September 2026 Windows 11 security updates. [...]</article>

items.title: Drupal warns of critical Commerce Core flaw exploited in attacks
items.author: Sergiu Gatlan
items.content: <article>Drupal warned admins to patch a critical access bypass vulnerability in the Commerce Core module that attackers are exploiting in the wild. [...]</article>

items.title: Binance links $6.3 billion crypto theft to compromised DevOps laptop
items.author: Sergiu Gatlan
items.content: <article>Binance, the world's largest crypto exchange, has linked the theft of about $6.3 billion in cryptocurrency to a DevOps engineer's compromised laptop. [...]</article>

items.title: OpenAI doubles ChatGPT Pro usage limits after backlash over planned 50% cut
items.author: Mayank Parmar
items.content: <article>OpenAI says it won't reduce usage limits for the $100, $200, and $500 ChatGPT Pro plans, as well as Business Premium, and it also promised to keep Dots usage independent. [...]</article>

items.title: Binance probes potential $5.8 billion crypto-theft hack
items.author: Lawrence Abrams
items.content: <article>Cryptocurrency exchange Binance is investigating a potential security breach involving up to $5.8 billion in digital assets, in what could become the largest cryptocurrency hack in history. [...]</article>
